recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, close-up portrait of a blonde woman wearing a vibrant red hoodie, with the hood pulled up. The composition is split vertically, with the subject occupying the left two-thirds and a textured, light-filled background on the right containing stacked, irregular hand-drawn typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The red hoodie acts as a bold frame for the subject's face and blonde hair.
The high-key lighting washes out the right side, creating a canvas for the text.
The jittery, hand-drawn text contrasts with the soft, photographic realism of the portrait.
The subject's direct gaze creates an intimate connection with the viewer.
coreInvariants: Vibrant red hoodie as the primary color anchor
High-key exposure on the right side of the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned on the left, cropped at the shoulders and top of the head, filling approximately 65% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's left eye and the saturated red of the hoodie fabric.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eye, follows the curve of the hood down to the right, and then moves upward through the stacked text blocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the image is dominated by bright, blown-out negative space with a subtle halftone or mesh texture.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright White (High-key background and skin highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red garment against a high-value, low-saturation background.

letterConstructionRules: Varying line weights within single characters
Hand-drawn imperfections with sharp, angular corners
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'A' and 'M' have exaggerated peaks
Circular letters like 'O' are drawn as irregular, tall ovals

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the overexposed background area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style variation where size and weight differentiate the artist name from the title.
graphicDevices: Halftone mesh pattern in the background highlights

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, indie-pop energy of the original.
Matches the verticality and stroke quality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A close-up portrait of a woman with blonde hair wearing a bright red hoodie. The lighting is extremely bright from the right, causing the right side of the image to fade into a white, textured background with a subtle mesh pattern. The left side shows her face in soft focus with dark eyeliner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add four lines of hand-drawn, tall, condensed black lettering on the right side. The text should look like it was drawn with a marker, featuring irregular lines and sharp angles.

verificationChecks: Is the hoodie a vibrant, saturated red?
Is the right side of the image significantly overexposed?
Does the text look hand-drawn rather than digitally typeset?
Is the subject's face partially framed by the hood?

adjustableVariables: Hoodie color (could be swapped for blue or yellow)
Degree of jitter in the lettering
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Any specific brand logos on the hoodie
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the hand-drawn style.
Check that the red hoodie doesn't bleed into the skin tones.
Verify the halftone texture is subtle and doesn't distract from the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-saturation garment portrait with a high-key, textured background and vertically-stacked, hand-drawn condensed lettering for an urban-indie aesthetic.
